adjudication.rationale: The GoogleCalendarService comment and blank line are purely stylistic, but the EventManager change is a real, diff-grounded limitation: it now destructures only the first destination calendar (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];`) and uses that single entry to decide whether to fall back from Google Meet (`if (evt.location === MeetLocationType && mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== "google_calendar")`). With `destinationCalendar` now an array, this can produce incorrect behavior when the first destination calendar isn’t Google but another destination calendar is (the comment explicitly acknowledges the limitation rather than handling it).
